import numpy as np, collections, os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        kk,hh,ww=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:hh]]
        if kk not in G and all(len(r)==ww and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[kk]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import numpy as np, os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        kk,hh,ww=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:hh]]
        if kk not in G and all(len(r)==ww and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[kk]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
T=np.array(G['Test input']); s=T.shape[0]; H=s
P=T[nz:=np.argwhere(T!=0)]
print('test bbox ok:', (nz[:,0].min(),nz[:,0].max(),nz[:,1].min(),nz[:,1].max()))
P=T[np.argwhere(T!=0)[:,0].min():np.argwhere(T!=0)[:,0].max()+1,
    np.argwhere(T!=0)[:,1].min():np.argwhere(T!=0)[:,1].max()+1]
O=np.array([[P[min(i,j)%H][min(i,j)%H] for j in range(2*H)] for i in range(2*H)])
print(json.dumps(O.tolist()))
